title: Grateful Dead Live at San Francisco State University on 1966-10-02

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of an experimental Acid Test show packed with eerie prankster sound collages and haunting piano, delivered with clear audio.
ai_review.review: The two reviewers rate this 1966 Acid Test performance highly, highlighting its dark psychedelic atmosphere, the “Prankster Sound Collage” pieces and a spooky piano segment. No recording flaws are mentioned, and the .sbd source suggests a clean soundboard capture that lets the oddball textures shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are very positive (4‑5 stars) and praise the unique performance; no recording complaints were noted, leading to a high combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not report any audio problems; the soundboard source is presumed clear and well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is described as a creepy, psychedelic journey with experimental sound collages interspersed throughout, creating an unsettling but compelling atmosphere.
